title: Wire Sketchpad To Optimized Flatten Design Cache
description: Refactor compose sketchpad so the flat piece plane/center recomputation uses the new merkle-hash-backed flattenDesignCached API. Drag, move, delete, paste, undo/redo, and every other kit mutation currently trigger a full flattenDesign in usePiecesMetadataMap → piecesMetadata. With the cache, only pieces whose merkle hash changed (i.e. actual downstream children of a mutated piece/connection) should rerun matrix math and attribute recomputation; everything else reuses the cached plane/center. Also make nativeDragPieces/nativeMovePieces/nativeFlatDesign and mcpFlattenDesignForComposeSurface use the cache, so repeated pre/post-flatten calls and MCP viewer refetches reuse unchanged piece outputs. Step 1 is to make the TS flattenDesignCached truly incremental (today it still calls the full flattenDesign underneath; only output object references get reused). Step 2 is to thread the cache through piecesMetadata → usePiecesMetadataMap and the native adapter so sketchpad benefits.
summary:
Made TS flattenDesignCached truly incremental and wired every sketchpad-path caller to it with a persistent per-designGuid cache so only descendants of a mutated piece/connection redo matrix math.

Library (compose/js/index.ts):
- Rewrote flattenDesignCached from a thin wrapper around flattenDesign into a self-contained BFS that computes {planeHash,centerHash} on the fly for each piece, and when a piece's hash matches the prior cache entry reuses the cached Piece object wholesale — skipping computeChildPlane+roundPlane (three.js matrix math), the parent-center propagation, and setAttributes for compose.fixedPieceId/depth/path/parentPieceId. Only pieces with a hash mismatch pay the full cost. Added flatPiece?: Piece to FlatMerkleCacheEntry so the whole flat piece (plane+center+attributes) is cached together, not just plane/center.
- Added piecesMetadataCached(kit, designGuid, cache?) that threads the merkle cache through to flattenDesignCached and returns {result, cache}; identical output shape to piecesMetadata.

Sketchpad (compose/sketchpad/index.tsx):
- Imported piecesMetadataCached + FlatMerkleCacheEntry.
- usePiecesMetadataMap now holds a module-level Map<designGuid, cache> (flatMerkleCacheByDesignRef) across renders. Each kit/designScope change feeds the prior cache into piecesMetadataCached and stores the returned cache. Only pieces whose merkle inputs changed are recomputed. On design switch prior designs stay cached.

UI viewers (compose/ui/index.tsx):
- mcpFlattenDesignForComposeSurface now holds a per-designGuid cache (mcpFlattenMerkleCacheByDesign) and uses flattenDesignCached. Repeated MCP viewer refetches (which send slightly-updated kit shells with the same geometry) reuse unchanged piece placements.
- Dropped the flattenDesign import; use flattenDesignCached everywhere.

Native algorithm adapter (compose/algorithms/nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts):
- Added a module-level Map<designGuid, FlatMerkleCacheEntry[]> cache shared across nativeFlattenDesign / nativeDragPieces / nativeMovePieces on the TS path. The pre-flatten in drag/move primes the cache; the post-flatten reuses it, so only the dragged/moved subtree recomputes. Other languages (python/rust/go/csharp) keep their stateless REST path.

Tests (compose/js/index.ts FlattenMerkle describe):
- Added 4 new tests beyond the 3 cross-language parity tests: (1) cached flatten returns a structurally identical forward diff vs fresh flattenDesign (ignoring non-deterministic attribute guids minted by guid()), (2) cached flatten preserves exact Piece/plane/center object references when merkle hash is unchanged — ref-stable across re-runs, (3) root plane mutation invalidates every descendant planeHash but keeps centerHashes ref-stable (plane and center chains are independent), (4) single connection u mutation keeps all plane refs stable and only recomputes centers on the affected subtree — the 'drag only recomputes children' scenario.

Verification:
- `npx vitest run -t 'Flatten'` → 14/14 passed.
- `npx vitest run -t 'FlattenMerkle'` → 7/7 passed.
- `npx vitest run` → 229/230 (only unrelated cargo-missing failure in ExportDesignModel, pre-existing).
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in compose/js, compose/ui, compose/algorithms, compose/sketchpad: no new errors introduced; only the pre-existing set from FIX-SKETCHPAD-DRAG-PERFORMANCE-REGRESSIONS (panelVisibility/CollaborativeKitStore/TutorialMilestone/etc.).
